exposure: Non-cephalic position of twin A only
non-cephalic position of twin A only
cohort: Women with a twin pregnancy who delivered at a gestational age of 32+0-41+0 weeks
finding: Planned and intrapartum cesarean section in twins had comparable predictors: non-cephalic position of both twins or twin A only, previous cesarean section, nulliparity, advanced maternal age, and pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: Non-cephalic position of one or both twins, previous cesarean section, nulliparity, advanced maternal age, and pre-eclampsia were all predictors of both planned and intrapartum cesarean delivery in twin pregnancies.
